second_repair_2026_08_07.reopen_reason: Same two findings re-raised after the first repair: worker reports passing tests while a required automated-test artifact reports a failed test run.
second_repair_2026_08_07.why_the_first_repair_did_not_clear: The first repair explained the defect by quoting the offending tallies verbatim inside the field describing them. Quoting reproduced them. The scanner matches the literal pattern wherever it occurs — including inside its own explanation — so the artifact went on parsing as a failed run while reading, to a human, as a completed fix. A narrated defect string is still a defect string.
second_repair_2026_08_07.root_cause_confirmed_empirically: Ran every JSON artifact in this directory through the Director's own parser (parseTestEvidenceSemantics in scripts/local-dev/lib/vacilando/deliverable-evidence.mjs), whole-file and field-by-field. wave1-reissue-evidence.json parsed as failed; the single offending field was evidence_repair.what_the_director_saw. All 12 other artifacts parsed clean. The mechanism is deliverable-evidence.mjs:39 — the first /\b(\d+)\s+failed\b/i match in the text sets failed_count, and any non-zero value sets the suite status, regardless of surrounding narrative.
second_repair_2026_08_07.fix: Rewrote that field to describe the probe tallies rather than reproduce them. No count string in suite-result form remains anywhere in this directory.
second_repair_2026_08_07.verification_after_fix: Re-ran the same whole-file and per-field parse over all 13 artifacts: every one parses clean, none reports a failed run.
second_repair_2026_08_07.durable_lesson: Evidence repair must delete the triggering pattern, not annotate it. Negative-fixture observations belong in prose that never uses suite-result form — report assertions that fired, not a count in the shape of a run.

third_repair_2026_08_07.reopen_reason: The same two findings raised a THIRD time after two repairs that both edited files in this repository.
third_repair_2026_08_07.why_the_first_two_repairs_could_not_have: Both repairs rewrote artifact prose in this directory. The Director never reads this directory when it judges the test check. `deliverable-evidence.mjs:174` builds its parse input from `evidence.title + evidence.description` — the record in the mission's evidence gallery — and ignores `evidence.fileUri` entirely. The file this repair keeps editing is referenced by a `fileUri` that is not even set on the test evidence (it is null). Two repairs therefore corrected a document the check does not consult, and the check went on reporting exactly what it had always reported. Neither repair was wrong about its own text; both were looking in the wrong store.

offending_record.what_is_wrong_with_it: Its description reports the two non-vacuity probes using per-probe assertion tallies written in suite-result form — a non-zero integer directly ahead of the word the parser keys on. Deliberately not quoted here: quoting it is what defeated the first repair. The probes themselves behaved correctly and were reverted before commit; only the phrasing is at fault.

third_repair_2026_08_07.why_attaching_more_evidence_cannot_clear: `evaluateAssignmentTests` (deliverable-evidence.mjs:239-240) computes `suiteFailed = semantics.some(s => s.test_run_status === 'failed')` over EVERY test-type evidence record for the assignment, then sets `suitePassed = semantics.some(passed) && !suiteFailed`. One record that parses as a failed run vetoes the whole assignment, and newer records do not outrank older ones. `listEvidence(missionId, {assignmentId})` (evidence.mjs:122) applies no recency, attempt, or supersede filter — note that `listDeliverableReviews` DOES take `includeSuperseded`, so the evidence store is the one place in this pipeline with no way to retract a record. `attachEvidence` is the only mutator; there is no update and no delete.
third_repair_2026_08_07.consequence: This assignment cannot clear the finding by any action available to it. Re-running the validation produces a green record that is ignored. Rewriting artifacts edits a file the check does not read. The one action that would clear it — retracting or superseding ev_4fb9be489ef3bd37 — means writing to the Director's own append-only audit log, outside the worktree, which is not a worker's to do and is not something a worker should do to make a check go green.

third_repair_2026_08_07.durable_lesson: An evidence-repair reopen is only actionable if the worker can reach the thing being parsed.
